changelog: - **`trial-reminders`: the job that keeps a trial from running out in silence** (#2415, #2410, #2417, #2418, #2416, story #2392). New `src/lib/jobs/trialReminders.ts` (`runTrialReminders()` + `initTrialRemindersCron()`, registered from `/api/cron/start` at 05:20 UTC and runnable on its own through `GET /api/cron?job=trial-reminders`, optionally narrowed with `&orgId=`). The sweep is per tenant and gated by `verticalFor(orgId)` — a sessionless job binds its own org with `runWithOrg()` rather than inheriting one. The recipient is the record's `mentorId` (the account owner in MARKETING terms); a record parked on a deactivated account falls back to the ADMINs **of that org only**, never every admin on the platform. Both channels go out behind their own switch — `notifyIfAllowed(…, 'deadlines', 'trial.endingSoon', …)` for the bell and `emailAllowed()` + `emailGroupAllowedForCategory()` for the mail, on the existing `stage-deadline` category with no new category and no new preference key — each send in its own try/catch, and the job returns `{ considered, sent, skipped, failed, expired, orgs }`. **Baseline (#2410): a lower bound, not a backfill** — the selector is an exact calendar-day match, so an elapsed trial equals no threshold ever again, and `findDueTrialReminders` bounds `trialEndsAt` to a window two days either side of the ladder; the decision is recorded in the header of `prisma/backfill-cron-baseline.mjs` beside the existing entries, and a `TRIAL_REMINDER_MAX_PER_RUN = 50` ceiling (modelled on `DORMANT_NUDGE_MAX_PER_RUN`) drains the queue most-urgent-first so a capped tick sheds the marks the ladder can absorb. **Auto-advance (#2417):** a trial whose last day is past moves from the tenant's `TRIAL_ACTIVE` stage to `TRIAL_EXPIRED` through a conditional `updateMany`, so a human who moved the row first wins; `stageDeadlineUpdate()` sets the new stage's clock; the audit row is `AuditLog` + `actorId: 'system'` (as `expireOffers()` does) because `StatusChange.changedById` is a required FK to `User` and a system user would be a real account on somebody's seat count. `TRIAL_EXPIRED` stays `isOffPath: false`, so `validateDropoffReason()` never applies to an unattended move. **Attention queue (#2418):** a new `'trial_expired'` reason in `src/lib/mentorAttention.ts` lists records waiting for a decision, labelled from the dictionary in all three languages — no new board card and no second time-in-stage calculation (`src/lib/stageClock.ts` still owns that). `e2e/trial-reminders-job.spec.ts` seeds a MARKETING tenant with a trial exactly seven days out, calls the endpoint twice as ADMIN and asserts one `TrialReminder` row, one bell item, one expiry audit row and `sent: 0` on the second run — with no SMTP configured and no new mail transport mode.

en: Trial reminders now go out on their own: the owner of an account hears seven days, three days and one last time on the day the trial ends — once per mark, never twice.

A trial that has run out no longer sits on the board as a running one. It moves to "Trial expired" by itself, unless somebody already moved it, and shows up in the owner's "Needs attention" list until they decide what happens next.
tr: Deneme hatırlatmaları artık kendi başına gidiyor: hesabın sahibi bitişe yedi gün, üç gün ve son gün kala haber alıyor — her eşik için bir kez, asla iki kez.

Süresi dolan bir deneme panoda artık "sürüyor" gibi durmuyor. Kimse elle taşımadıysa kendiliğinden "Deneme süresi doldu" aşamasına geçiyor ve karar verilene kadar sahibinin "Dikkat gerekiyor" listesinde görünüyor.
de: Testphasen-Erinnerungen laufen jetzt eigenständig: Die Inhaberin oder der Inhaber eines Kontos hört sieben Tage, drei Tage und ein letztes Mal am Endtag davon — je Stufe einmal, nie zweimal.

Eine abgelaufene Testphase steht nicht länger als laufende auf dem Board. Sie wechselt von selbst zu "Testphase abgelaufen", sofern sie niemand schon bewegt hat, und erscheint bis zur Entscheidung in der Liste "Braucht Aufmerksamkeit".
